quarterly_data.signal: In the release announcing the mutual termination of the Element Solutions merger agreement, Solstice affirmed its increased full-year 2026 guidance, which includes Adjusted EBITDA of $1,035 - $1,055 million and Adjusted Diluted EPS of $2.75 - $2.95 (the affirmed net sales ranges are recorded from the same-day 8-K). CEO David Sewell: 'As demonstrated by our reported results and recently increased guidance, which we are reaffirming today, the Solstice team is executing well and with discipline across our operations.'
